22. Defendant No. 5 the Chittagong Development Authority also contested the suit by filing separate written statement stating inter-alia, that the suit is barred under Section 91 of the Chittagong Development Authority Ordinance, 1959 and also barred under the law of limitation and that the plaintiff has no locus standi to file the suit and that the suit is not maintainable in its present form; contending further that 5.50+ 5.88 acres totaling 11.38 acres comprising Plot Nos. 49(P) and 50 and 50(A) of Kalurghat Heavy Industrial Estate were alloted Manzar & Co. but no Lease Deed was executed; though delivery of possession was made to them. The said allotment was cancelled by Memo No. E.O. /K. Ghat /49(P) -50/1142, dated 14.3.75. Thereafter the suit land was alloted to M/s. Kabir Ahmed on 15.10.75 but the same was also cancelled due to non-payment of premium and Chittagong Development Authority accordingly took back the possession. 

 44. Mr. M. Nurullah submits that the lease was cancelled in 1975 by Chittagong Development Authority but the suit was filed in 1982 and as such the suit against Chittagong Development Authority is barred under Article 113 of the Limitation Act. 

 46. Mr. M. Nurullah also submits that the plaintiff by his letter dated 20.7.76 Ext. A(I) addressed to the Disinvestment Board, asked for re-fund of earnest money paid and since the Disinvestment Board remained silent that constituted a refusal to implement the contract for sale and as such the suit is barred under Article 114 of the Limitation Act as against Government as well. 

 48. And only on 26.6.81 (Exhibit 'J') the Government informed the plaintiff that the auction sale was cancelled and the suit was filed in 1982 therefore we do not find that the suit is barred by limitation even against the Government. We also noticed from the record Exhibit G(1) (P 372-380 paper book) that the Disinvestment Board had the intention as late as 29.12.79 to transfer the suit property to the plaintiff therefore it can be said that the suit filed in 1982 was barred by the law of limitation.
